details: When using the "lock" feature with the redesigned camera, any time you swap between pins it unlocks the camera so it can be grabbed and moved, but the lock feature switch still shows active.  HOW TO REPLICATE: 1) store some settings as pin#1 2) store some different settings as pin#2 3) enable lock feature so camera is locked in place 4) swap between pins 5) camera is now unlocked and movable 6) go look at the lock feature switch.  it still shows locked even though the camera is no longer locked. you have to unlock and relock with the switch every time you change pins.  SHOULD BE: lock state is stored with the pin like other settings.  WHY: for streaming I want a front view pin and a side view pin where the camera lens is detached from the screen and locked in place so i can't accidentally move it, and i want a third pin where the camera lens is default behavior attached to the screen and the whole thing is movable (unlocked).
title: Camera locking not stored with pins
